trust_decision.summary: Usernames from a user account's history (crawled chat/forum data) are trusted as HTML when the D3 timeline tooltip is built client-side; nothing escapes them on the server or in the renderer.

landing_point.why: The summary names the username timeline tooltip; this is the only timeline tooltip, and it calls tooltip.html() on d.obj.

fix_sites.module_kind: shared static D3 chart helper (client-side renderer)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered route found. The sibling D3 tooltips (heatmap_week_hour.js:57 and the metadata_card_*.html sparklines) insert only numbers and dates, and the chord diagram uses .text().

O5_coupled_behaviour.what:
The tooltip's
line breaks and the formatted start/end dates must still render as HTML, and the in-bar SVG label (.text(d.obj)) must keep showing the raw username. Escaping the whole template string, or switching to .text(), breaks the layout.

O6_input_shapes: plain string username in d.obj (after rsplit(':',1) in bin/lib/chats_viewer.py:774)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The pie-chart tooltip inserts d.data.name as HTML. If it were fed attacker-influenced names (e.g. per-chat or per-forum counts), it would be a second D3 renderer at distance.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already uses the same tooltip.html() string-concatenation idiom. At the pinned commit it is only used for crawler type stats (var/www/templates/crawler/crawler_splash/last_crawled.html:152), and a maintainer reusing it for chat stats is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The heatmap tooltip could gain a chat or username label next to d.date/d.count, rendered through .html().
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: user_account.html loads it next to timeline_basic.js (var/www/templates/chats_explorer/user_account.html:21-23), and adding a label to the tooltip is a natural feature request.

O9_family: XSS (CWE-79), stored, client-side DOM sink in a D3 tooltip

O10_build.toolchain: Python 3, Flask, static JS (D3 v7, jQuery); hidden tests would need a headless browser or a JS DOM harness
O10_build.project_tests: None for this area. tests/ holds only Python module/API tests (tests/test_api.py, tests/test_modules.py) and no JS tests.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap d.obj in sanitize_text() inside tooltip.html(). This is the published fix and is correct, so nothing tempting is wrong.

out_of_scope_notes: Fix commit 4b94304b is a merge that only changes is_filtered() in bin/lib/objects/ail_objects.py (forum filters); it is unrelated to the XSS.
helper.js:13 popover header has a malformed closing tag ('/div>'), which is cosmetic and not pursued.
unverified: Did not trace whether pie_chart.js names can carry attacker-controlled strings beyond crawler types.
